keyPhrases.text: everything about the campy little show...is foolhardy
should probably have been left in a basement rec room
big but sparse and ugly set
Prince, by hook or crook, will make you laugh

reasoning: Harsh criticism dominates this review with phrases like 'foolhardy,' 'should have been left in a basement rec room,' 'amateur staging,' and 'ugly set.' While there are brief positive mentions of two performers (Simard and Prince), the overall tone is scathing and the review clearly does not recommend the show. The critic systematically dismantles multiple aspects of the production.
